help_menu.title: 📚 ** Putre - Help Menu**
help_menu.description: **Description** Role Agent Bot is an LLM agent with loaded personality, has long-term memory and can interact with the user.
help_menu.roles_section: **Roles** Role modules are some bot capabilities to provide some services to users.
help_menu.behavior_section: **Behavior** In this section you will configure some interactable bot behaviors. Admins only
help_menu.shortcuts_section: **Shortcuts** Configure up to 5 quick access buttons in the Canvas home view for your favorite roles and subroles. Available in Settings > Shortcuts.

conversation.title: 💬  **Putre - Conversation**
conversation.description:
**Description:**
 -Putre will react to DM and mentions. -Has persistent and interactive memory, you can ask about something that happened, he might pay enough attention to remember it. -Also depending on roles and behaviors, he can react to different words. In taboo behavior you can configure a word for him to react to.

greetings.title: 👋  **Putre - Greetings**
greetings.description:
**Description:**
 - Greets users when they connect to Discord.
 - Waits 5 min before counting user as disconnected.
 - Recognizes if not replied to when greeting, and stops greeting.

welcome.title: 🍺  **Putre - Welcome**
welcome.description:
**Description:**
 - Welcomes new users to the server.

taboo.title: 🚫  **Putre - Taboo Words**
taboo.description:
**How it works:**
 - Configure Putre to react when reading a word through a channel or DM.
 - Can be activated/deactivated or configure the words.
